name: Binaural recording
summary: A recording with two mics set at ear distance, so that a sound seems to move around the head of the listener.
how: Set two mics 17cm apart, or use a head with an ear mic on each side.
Keep the source within 30cm for a close sound.
Move an object from left to right slowly.
Give the listener a pair of headphones.

origin.note: Clement Ader sends stereo telephone sound from the Paris Opera to listeners at the Electrical Exhibition, an early use of two-channel sound.

adoptions.via: Close-mic video channels use binaural mics to make whispers and taps move between the ears.
